name: Graco SnugRide 35 Lite LX

verifiedAttributes._comment: carrierLb / fitsWayfinder / fitsAlterrain / safety map into seed.json attributes; the rest is audit trail.
verifiedAttributes.safety: basic — no load leg or anti-rebound bar; meets federal side-impact standard, ProtectPlus Engineered, FAA-approved
verifiedAttributes.bobWayfinderAdapter: none — BOB has no Wayfinder Graco adapter (Wayfinder's universal adapter only serves Nuna/Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Britax-Willow/Diono)
verifiedAttributes.bobAlterrainAdapter: BOB Gear Single Jogging Stroller Adapter for Graco Infant Car Seats — $99.99 (fits Alterrain / Alterrain Pro)
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: No direct Toyota Tacoma data found. Compact front-to-back with a ~17–17.5 in carrier width; reviewers call it a good pick for tight/small back seats and 3-across. Offers European (baseless) belt routing to save depth. Carrier is one of the lightest at 7.2 lb.

notes: FLAG (b) RESOLVED — fitsAlterrain = TRUE (stub already had true; confirmed). bobgear.com's own Graco adapter page lists compatibility with 'All SnugRide models, SnugRide Click Connect models, SnugRide SnugLock models'. The 'stay-in-car-base LATCH install' concern conflates the CAR base (a stay-in-car LATCH base) with the STROLLER attachment: the Lite LX carrier uses the standard Graco Click-Connect carrier notch that latches into the BOB Graco adapter, independent of the base type. So it does click in. No Wayfinder Graco adapter exists, so fitsWayfinder stays false. Pricing: lowest in-stock is Target $139.99; Babylist $219.98 is a SEAT + EXTRA BASE bundle (not a standalone — flagged so it isn't mistaken for a standalone price); Klarna also shows eBay $122.99 / Kohl's $139.99. Keep price=130 as MSRP fallback per SOURCING.md. carrierLb 7.2 confirmed (Graco + retailer spec).
